levels.surface: أبي بكر عبيد الله ابن موسى الحبال الطبري

notes: Letter of Amir al-Mu'minin to Sahl b. Hanif: a rescript-type text (rule 11). The author is named in the opening («فروي أن أمير المؤمنين ... قال»), not in the chain, which ends at the unnamed fathers «آبائه».
«الصادق جعفر بن محمد» is inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2).
Editor's note «(1)» and «(عليهم السلام)» left out.

fixes.reason: The first link is written as «علي بأحمد», apparently a fused «علي بن أحمد»; the surface is kept exactly as written.
